title: Rectangular prism
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on a new face. This sketch will consist of a single loop made up of four lines. The first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.0197, 0.0). The second line extends from (0.0197, 0.0) to (0.0197, 0.0296). The third line runs from (0.0197, 0.0296) to (0.0, 0.0296), and the fourth line completes the loop by going from (0.0, 0.0296) back to the origin. After creating the sketch, apply a scale factor of 0.0296 to it. Ensure that the sketch remains aligned with the original coordinate system by setting the Euler angles and translation vector to zero during the transformation. Finally, extrude the scaled sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction to create a solid body. The final dimensions of the rectangular prism will be a length of 0.019736842105263153 units, a width of 0.02960526315789473 units, and a height of 0.75 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.0197, 0).lineTo(0.0197, 0.0296).lineTo(0, 0.0296).close()

# Extrude the sketch
extrusion = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Create the final model
r = extrusion

lanes.label: Cadabra 4B (ours) · 1 sample

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a sketch on the XY plane
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0197, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0197, 0.0296) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0296) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create a rectangular section
r = r.extrude(0.75)
